prompt: Each input line has the form 'Record <id>: <date> (<note>)' where id and note are irrelevant. Convert the embedded date to ISO YYYY-MM-DD, one per output line, same order. Supported date forms: 'D Mon YYYY' (English month), 'YYYY/MM/DD', 'Mon D, YYYY'. Output only the converted dates.
notes: Hidden dates seed: mixed supported forms; never exposed in benchmarks/.

prompt: Parse the input as CSV (RFC 4180: comma delimiter, double-quote quoting, first row is the header). Ignore the 'internal_flag' column. Output a JSON array of objects with keys name, city, note taken from the columns of the same names (all values strings, row order preserved). Output only the JSON.
notes: Hidden CSV seed: quoted commas, doubled quotes, embedded newline, permuted columns, ignored column.

prompt: The input is one JSON object. Flatten it: nested objects become dot-separated keys; array elements become key[i]; scalars are unchanged. Output the flat JSON object. Output only the JSON.
notes: Hidden records seed: nested arrays, unicode, bool/null/float scalars.
